svg.text: Transfer-Chain Depth, Opacity & Jurisdiction-Hopping Exposure Analytics Pattern
Detects complex transfer chains engineered to sever a seed account's funds from an identifiable source.

g.text: Adriatic Union Bank - Old Town Branch
9 transfer hops before the trail goes cold
• Deep transfer chain before the trail cools
BA008 detects seed-account funds pushed through
a deep, opaque, cross-border transfer chain built to
sever the audit trail from their source. It quantifies
chain depth and intermediary opacity, corroborates
the finding with jurisdiction-hopping evidence, and
tracks value fragmentation across the chain. Chains
that would otherwise pass as ordinary correspondent-
banking activity on each leg are surfaced and escalated.

svg.text: BUILDING THE FOUNDATION FOR NETWORK INTELLIGENCE AND GRAPH-BASED FINANCIAL CRIME INVESTIGATIONS
